title: Billing Calendar Note: Vehicle Changes near the End of a Billing Period, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Note.** The fee for a change of vehicle on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is further multiplied according to where the handling date falls in the billing period:

- by **0.6** where the most recently charged billing period ends no more than 7 days after the handling date (a period end already passed included);
- by **0.8** where it ends more than 7 but no more than 14 days after it;
- otherwise this note makes no adjustment.

The multiplication acts on the swap fee level, together with anything else the level is multiplied by, and is not rounded at this point; the fee is rounded to the cent at the end. Days are calendar days from the handling date to the last day of the most recently charged billing period.

### Calendar boundaries (hypothetical; most recently charged period 5 March to 4 April)

| Handling date | Days to 4 April | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 28 March | 7 | 0.6 |
| 27 March | 8 | 0.8 |
| 21 March | 14 | 0.8 |
| 20 March | 15 | no adjustment |

Worked figure: a fee of $25.00 at this point becomes $15.00 with 0.6 and $20.00 with 0.8.
